tunnels.name: Beth
tunnels.power: Miracles of healing, gift of tongues, knowledge of sciences

tunnels.name: Gimel
tunnels.power: The white tincture, clairvoyance, divination by dreams
tunnels.averse: The veil become a wall. Barren secrecy, sterile moon, fixation on the hidden for its own sake.

tunnels.name: Daleth
tunnels.averse: Fertility inverted: the devouring mother. Flesh without love; Venus as appetite.

tunnels.name: He
tunnels.trump: XVII The Star (Crowley/Grant) · IV The Emperor (GD)
tunnels.averse: Hope inverted: the false light, the sterile star. Vision that leads nowhere; consecration of the profane.

tunnels.name: Vau
tunnels.averse: Dogma as tyranny. Hollow ritual, false initiation; the nail that fixes instead of joins.

tunnels.name: Zain
tunnels.power: Being in two or more places at once; prophecy
tunnels.averse: Division: the sword that only cuts apart. Broken union, paralysis of choice, the twin that betrays.

tunnels.name: Cheth
tunnels.averse: The vehicle without a driver. Momentum with no control; armour that has become a prison.

tunnels.name: Teth
tunnels.averse: Appetite unbridled. Ecstasy that consumes; the Beast without the Woman riding it.

tunnels.name: Yod
tunnels.averse: Isolation and sterility. The seed unsown; the lamp hoarded; light that never leaves the cell.

tunnels.name: Kaph
tunnels.power: Power of acquiring political and other ascendancy
tunnels.averse: Fatalism: the wheel as a cage. Luck divorced from will; rise and fall with no lesson.

tunnels.name: Lamed
tunnels.averse: Injustice: the unbalanced scale. Karma as vengeance; judgment with no measure.

tunnels.name: Mem
tunnels.averse: Drowning. Surrender become stagnation; the waters of the Abyss closing over the head.

tunnels.name: Nun
tunnels.averse: Putrefaction with no renewal. Death fixated upon; the scorpion that stings itself.

tunnels.name: Samekh
tunnels.power: Transmutations; vision of the Universal Peacock
tunnels.averse: Failed alchemy. Forces mixed that should not mix; poison instead of elixir; the arrow that falls short.

tunnels.name: Ayin

tunnels.averse: Bondage: matter taken as the whole. The goat with no eye above it; the joke nobody gets.

tunnels.name: Pe
tunnels.averse: Destruction without renewal. War, ruin, catastrophe; the mouth that only curses.

tunnels.name: Tzaddi
tunnels.trump: IV The Emperor (Crowley/Grant) · XVII The Star (GD)
tunnels.averse: Tyranny: authority without legitimacy. Sterile rule; the hook that holds but does not feed.

tunnels.name: Qoph
tunnels.averse: Illusion and sorcery. Nightmare, the dark tide, the path that doubles back; fear in the reptile brain.

tunnels.name: Resh

tunnels.averse: The black sun. Glare that blinds; vanity; false enlightenment; the face with nothing behind it.

tunnels.name: Shin
tunnels.averse: Fire that annihilates rather than transforms. False judgment; apocalypse as an end, not a birth.

tunnels.name: Tau
tunnels.averse: Matter as tomb. Imprisonment in form; the Universe as dead end; the cross with no resurrection.

qliphoth.averse: Duality where there should be unity: two contending heads on one crown. The will to be God rather than to unite with God.
Obstruction of the creative impulse: force with no channel, confusion of beginnings, energy that hinders what it should start.
Concealment: the veil that hides instead of reveals. Sterile mystery, secrecy for its own sake, the mother who withholds.
Mercy inverted into waste: prodigality, gluttony, dissipation. Giving that breaks the receiver.
Severity inverted into cruelty: wrath, destruction for its own sake, fire that consumes the one who wields it.
The false sun: ego enthroned at the centre. Vanity and ugliness in place of beauty; endless dispute instead of harmony.
Desire scattered: lust that divides rather than unites. Victory picked apart by the ravens.
The intellect as liar: sophistry, falsehood, poison dressed as reason. The Accuser.
The corrupted image: foul dreams, glamour, sexuality severed from meaning. The foundation rotted.

qliphoth.order: Queen of the Night / the Evil Woman
qliphoth.averse: Matter without spirit: the world as dead weight. Night with no dawn; the whisperers in the dark.

general.classical: The Goetia's method is compulsion: conjurations, constraints, curses, seals worn as lamens, and the Brass Vessel. It does not prescribe offerings as a general rule. The exceptions are Belial ('must have Offerings, Sacrifices and Gifts presented unto him by the Exorcist, or else he will not give True Answers') and Paimon ('if thou callest this Spirit Paimon alone, thou must make him some offering'). Malphas is a warning: he receives sacrifices 'kindly and willingly' but will deceive the one who makes them. Beleth must be received courteously and done homage. Neighbouring grimoires go further: the Grand Grimoire's pact with Lucifuge Rofocale demands a coin each month, and the Grimoire of Pope Honorius involves sacrificing a black cock.
general.modern: Modern practitioners broadly treat offerings as relationship-building or as payment for a completed task. Common offerings are incense, candles, alcohol, water, food (sweets, bread, honey, fruit), music, art, written praise, public thanks and charity. Aaron Leitch advises small offerings to attract a spirit and full payment only after results. He warns against paying unvetted or deceptive spirits up front (he cites Malphas). Many writers stress promising only what you can actually give. Blood offerings are controversial: some demonolatry currents use a few drops, while most Solomonic-leaning sources and sites like Goetic Impressions advise against them.
general.disposal: Classical sources say nothing on disposal. A common modern rule is to remove perishable food and drink after about a day, or once it has visibly 'been taken'. Then bury it, leave it at a crossroads or in nature (if it is biodegradable and safe for wildlife), pour liquids onto earth, or compost it, rather than throwing it in household trash. Candles and incense are usually left to burn out, with remains buried or discarded respectfully.
general.timingAdvice: The Goetia itself says to observe the Moon's age: 'The best days be when the Moon Luna is 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12, or 14 days old... and no other days be profitable.' That is even days of the waxing moon, alongside the rank hours above. Modern practice adds the planetary day and planetary hour of the rank's planet (e.g. a King on Sunday in a Sun hour) and a waxing moon for constructive aims. Another modern option uses the Golden Dawn / 777 decan attributions, where spirits 1-36 are day spirits and 37-72 night spirits across the 36 decans; many practitioners work when the Sun is in the spirit's decan or 5-degree quinance.
general.cautions: Agrippa's planetary fumes include animal brains and blood, and Saturnian recipes include poisonous henbane, mandrake and black poppy. Treat these as historical data and do not burn or offer them. Quicksilver is toxic, so use electrum or plated metal for Presidents' seals. Alcohol, flame and incense safety apply. Rank-to-planet-to-day links beyond the metals are later inference, not stated outright in the Goetia.
